purpose: Document first-party local registry context and bounded anonymous parcel-geometry access review for Yongkang, China.
assessment: Yongkang's official Natural Resources and Planning Bureau and Real Estate Registration Center are evidenced as local custodians for natural-resource, cadastral, and real-estate registration information. Zhejiang's official geographic-information public-service platform was identified as the provincial map route. The bounded anonymous fetch timed out before the current viewer configuration or public parcel API could be inspected; no geometry was retained.
